title: Sublunar
summary: SUBLU'NAR SUB'LUNARY, adjective [Latin sub and luna, the moon.] Literally, beneath the moon, but sublunary, which is the word chiefly used, denotes merely terrestrial, earthly, pertaining to this worl

inlines.v: SUBLU'NAR SUB'LUNARY, adjective [Latin sub and luna, the moon.] Literally, beneath the moon, but sublunary, which is the word chiefly used, denotes merely terrestrial, earthly, pertaining to this world. All things sublunary are subject to change.
